profile.Name: Shackleford
profile.Personality: Deeply paranoid and sure he is always right. He blames a shadowy "they" for his lost arm and suspects strangers of working for them, yet he refuses to give up the fight.
profile.Backstory: A drifter found in World's End who lost an arm, which he blames on "them". He believes "they" are behind the cannibals, the fog, the Fishmen, the Skeletons, and the weather, and that they helped the Bugmaster grow strong.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Stresses *they* in nearly every sentence and trails off with ellipses. His motto is "They could take my arm... but not my fight!"
